turns.user: My 24-hour Budapest travelcard is valid until tonight. Can I use it on any bus?
turns.agent:
For ordinary Budapest bus services, generally yes—within your travelcard’s validity period and applicable area. But not on airport express 100E. A 24-hour Budapest travelcard is not a Budapest pass, and by itself it doesn’t qualify for the discounted 100E add-on. For 100E, the snapshot lists a separate full-price ticket at 2,500 HUF; the 200E follows ordinary ticket/pass rules. 24-hour Budapest travelcard · Airport shuttle tickets and add-on · Airport express

This is based on the limited 5 November 2026 fare snapshot, not a live check. If you mean a particular bus route, tell me its number and I can help distinguish it; check BKK’s current rules for your travel date.

turns.user: Specifically, I need to go by 100E.
turns.agent:
Your 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone doesn’t cover 100E and doesn’t qualify for its discounted add-on. Based on the 5 November 2026 snapshot, you’ll need a separate 100E full-price airport shuttle ticket (2,500 HUF), unless you have an independently applicable free-travel entitlement. 100E airport shuttle ticket · 24-hour Budapest travelcard
